2. All four `X · Content · Text + Media` Media instances (265:552, 264:906, 260:1196, 252:788) are IMAGE fill, scaleMode **FILL**, image hash `8e847a4a…`; a 1:1 screenshot of 260:1192 shows the seagull whole — head in frame, no stretching.
3. Every id in the doc resolved to the node named there.

I agree with keeping `Image` 48:4583 live on Elements instead of archiving it: 36 instances depend on it, including all four Text+Media masters, so archiving would hide the base of every live photo from Assets — against the purpose of rule 29.
